target_customer: Teams with large volumes of unstructured text who need to query it by web app or API
problem: Answers often span many documents; Ardis extracted information into a knowledge graph so users could ask complex questions and see the evidence.
business_model: SaaS and API for knowledge graph generation from text

founders.name: Julie Lewis
founders.background_notes: YC page says she is now a software engineer at Ambience Healthcare.

competitors.name: Diffbot
competitors.what: Natural Language API that builds knowledge graph entities and relations from text
competitors.traction_then: established knowledge graph vendor; NLP API released in September 2020

technical_complexity.rationale: Reliable multi-document information extraction and question answering with evidence was a hard NLP problem for three people in 2020.

defensibility.rationale: The sources describe no proprietary data or integration; large language models and cloud NLP services were closing the gap.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not documented for Ardis. Diffbot shipped a competing text to knowledge graph API in 2020.

market_need_then: The YC description cites the need to answer questions across multiple documents. No dated spend or customer evidence was found.

branding.domain_note: Used ardis.ai; no purchase details found.

brand_strength.rationale: Only directory listings were found; the name shares spelling with unrelated people and organizations in search results.

outcome_analysis: Ardis AI was a three person Winter 2020 team building searchable knowledge graphs from text, with only a reported YC investment on record. The directory marks it inactive and the YC page shows a founder now employed elsewhere, but no shutdown announcement or cause is public, so failure factors stay empty.
notes: Company website returned HTTP 503 so it could not be read. The 150K figure rests on CB Insights alone; FundedIQ reports 200K and names a CEO called Julie Mecca, which conflicts with the YC page, so it is not used. The Diffbot source is about six months after the March 2020 batch. Directories disagree on founding year (2019 vs 2020) and location.
